term: particular contingent concrete plurality and explanation-to-bearer bridge
definition: Concrete is glossed as something that possibly causes something. Explanation concerns the fact that a selected plurality exists, and the second premise concerns all existing contingent concrete things. A necessary concrete thing is the bridge’s stated bearer conclusion, not the explanatory proposition identified with an individual.
note: Plural existence-fact coverage differs from individual existence PSR; aggregate admission, empty case, capability interpretation, fact/bearer conversion and rigid frame-relative necessity remain open. No actual cause, complete explanation or source truth is established.
